english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial word for a dollar in Hong Kong speech.

examples.english: This milk tea costs a dollar.
examples.jyutping: ni1 bui1 naai5 caa4 jiu3 jat1 man1

english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a mosquito.

examples.english: A mosquito is flying around my room.
examples.traditional: 有隻蚊喺我間房度飛來飛去。
examples.jyutping: jau5 zek3 man1 hai2 ngo5 gaan1 fong2 dou6 fei1 loi4 fei1 heoi3
